mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 60 degrees with clear skies at City Hall under a Waxing Gibbous moon. If you look toward the West Northwest over Cross Plains at 5:47 PM, you can catch the ISS cruising toward Madison.

The City of Verona is moving forward with a Public Works facility expansion to handle local growth, while also progressing on the Mark Drive reconstruction project to improve water and sewer infrastructure.
Today features Yoga at Insight Wellness and ART House 360, followed by Hop Haus Trivia tomorrow.
Regarding local police activity, on November 2, officers responded to a residence on West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Double Strawberry. The store is currently open and will remain ready to serve you until 10:00 PM.
